title: io.k8s.api.resource.v1.DeviceTaintRuleSpec
description: DeviceTaintRuleSpec specifies the selector and one taint.

deviceSelector.description: DeviceSelector defines which device(s) the taint is applied to. All selector criteria must be satisfied for a device to match. The empty selector matches all devices. Without a selector, no devices are matches.

taint.description: The taint that gets applied to matching devices.
